en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a cobblestone street lined with two- and three‑story townhouses. People walk along the left sidewalk and horse‑drawn carts are visible further down the street. Trees and a small square or garden appear on the right. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as Altenburger Strasse in Geithain, and the publisher line notes Brück & Sohn, Meissen, with the year 1905.
